title: Robot Motor Math and WiFi Resilience

generationOptions.episodeFocus: This podcast should feature a technical deep dive between a senior developer and a hobbyist roboticist. They should discuss the architecture of the provided Arduino sketch for an ESP8266-based robot. Key points to cover include: how the code manages dual WiFi modes (Station and Access Point) as a fail-safe, the logic behind mapping HTTP request arguments (like 'F' for forward or 'S' for stop) to specific motor control functions, and the implementation of speed control using PWM and a speed coefficient for turning. The tone should be instructional yet enthusiastic about DIY electronics, explaining how the code handles real-time commands and even OTA (Over-the-Air) updates to allow for wireless maintenance.
